method.method: Full sequential AI review of all current Azerbaijani/English definitions, POS and extra senses; every row with available dictionary, native dump or print evidence was compared with at least one relevant supplied source. Primary dictionary records were read for every available row; print fallbacks were compared, with selected full entries examined. Secondary displayed-sense coverage is separately recorded below; exhaustive review of every unshown source sense is not claimed.
method.secondary_senses_note: All 1,674 displayed secondary pairs in 978 entries assessed. 448 pairs were rewritten, removed as metadata/misclassification, or recast within corrected lexical entries. Existing valid wording may remain terse; all external dictionary senses beyond the displayed pairs are outside this secondary pass.
method.indirect_reference_note: Thirty previously uncited proposals now carry actually inspected print, explicit synonym/derived-term or dictionary citations. These indirect references do not imply independently verified headword entries. One unsupported/slang conflict was moved to holds.
method.secondary_sense_policy: Every user-visible secondary pair in otherSenses.slice(1) was explicitly read in AZ and EN with the available dictionary glosses. The 975 supplied headword records were compared using English senses where available or a selected other-edition record; the three missing headword records were compared using print or explicit historical sources. Concise original paraphrases correct homograph translation errors, grammatical labels, agency, register and context. Valid polysemy and seven previously corrected complete sense sets are preserved. Source agreement is not independent expert verification; one precise botanical identification is held. No professional lexicographic certification is claimed.

Mistaken referral to bəhs etmək (discuss); the sufficiency phrase is bəs etmək. These are different lexical expressions.
Mistaken referral to bəhs etmək (discuss); the sufficiency phrase is bəs etmək. These are different lexical expressions.
The synonym is licensed only for the compound qəhr olmaq, not the bare noun qəhr meaning wrath; a noun and an unrelated infinitive should not be joined through the missing compound.
A tuluq is an animal-skin container that may be used for churning; a nehrə is the churn itself, typically wood or clay. Shared use is association, not a synonym.
Şor is salty or a whey cheese; şorqoğalı is a spiced pastry. A component of a compound and a flavor descriptor do not make the food names synonymous.
The cited çırtlamaq sense is doing a task easily, not creating something. It does not support a synonym edge to yaratmaq.
Müraciətnamə is a written public appeal or proclamation; məktub is a letter. Shared Turkish mesaj does not establish interchangeable Azerbaijani meanings.
An ismarış is an instruction, order, or communicated message; informasiya is information generally. The shared Turkish bilgi gloss is too broad to establish synonymy.
Nər specifically names a male camel, while dəvə names camels of either sex. This is a subtype relationship, not synonymy.
Russian гордость collapses negative arrogance and positive pride. Azerbaijani print distinguishes təkəbbür as haughtiness and iftixar as proud satisfaction; no shared equivalent sense is established.
Koma denotes a hut/shack here, while kaha denotes a cave or hollow; dwelling association does not establish synonymy.
Qəşəng is an adjective meaning pretty/nice; vərəqə is a sheet or leaflet. Endpoint print evidence does not support a shared sense.
Pilləkən is a staircase; ayaqaltı is a mat, trodden place or figurative downtrodden person. A mat laid on stairs is not a synonym for stairs.
Yaxşı means good; vərəqə is a sheet or leaflet. No shared sense is supported by endpoint evidence.
Qazamat is prison generally, whereas islah evi is a reformatory, a particular institution; a broader association should not be an unqualified synonym.
Yönlü means suitable/good; vərəqə is a sheet or leaflet. Endpoint evidence does not support synonymy.
Əməlli means proper/decent; vərəqə means sheet/leaflet. Both endpoint print entries contradict the supposed shared sense.
Şorqoğalı is a savoury pastry, while şora is saltpeter. The pastry name does not make the chemical a synonym.
Tez means early in general; səhər-səhər specifies morning. Early arrival at night is tez but not səhər-səhər; broad early gloss cannot establish equivalence.
Print definitions distinguish buzov as an unweaned calf and dana as a calf aged one to two years. Same English calf gloss loses this age distinction.
The imported endpoint toxuc is a subject abbreviation: toxuc. = toxuculuq (weaving). It is not a synonym of warp; the print entry places it before the definition as a field label.
